name: Aqua Teen Hunger Force Destruct-O-Thon
summary: Meet Cartoon Network's most popular Adult Swim trio - Aqua Teen Hunger Force: Master Shake, the self-proclaimed leader, Meatwad, the dim but adorable uncooked meatball and Frylock, the only member of the group with any sense at all. Play as the Aqua Teen trio as they smash stuff, bash stuff and basically try to hit things as far as possible across 16 levels of surreal fun. Why? Why not! Who's gonna argue with a talking milkshake with an attitude?
